inclusion: Every WR pass launched in the window with a native pass outcome observed during the window or its fixed eight-second result tail; no-result plays are listed separately. The tail admits outcomes only for throws observed before the cutoff. Catch is the native pass result, not the final touchdown/score. Case numbers are local review references, not player identifiers.

cases.finding: Initial approach stalled and moved backward while avoidance tried to pass the blocker. Checked-path rejection withheld movement and sprint despite 75 stamina. The play was already far short at throw and never found a reachable catch plan.
specificEvidence: The first blocker was 5.394 studs ahead, closing at 11.977 studs/s; no walking heading within the current +/-90-degree candidate set satisfied the 4.75-stud clearance.
From about 0.10 to 0.72 s after route start, forward position changed from -21.43 to -25.89 studs; early avoidance records emitted zero movement direction.
The remaining stem required 28.75 studs with 9.58 studs of travel capacity, a 19.16-stud deficit.
All 14 post-throw forecasts were unreachable; ordinary later predicted misses were about 12.6-13.4 studs.
No native Jammed notification, jump, dive or local contact claim was observed.
cases.remainingUncertainty: Backward headings outside the current search pass an instantaneous clearance calculation, but no alternative is yet validated through the bounded turn, catch deadline and opponent response. This remains unresolved and is not a connected-contact failure.
cases.resolutionStatus: Observed failure; related fixes are not proof this exact play would now succeed

limits: Client contact callbacks are claims, not possession or proof the server accepted the catch.
A reachable forecast does not guarantee execution or victory against the opponent.
Related shipped changes have regression/replay support; individual historical outcomes are not proven reversed.
Versions faced different sequences of opponents and plays, so these small sequential counts are not a controlled efficacy estimate.
No player names, account identifiers, raw client code or credentials are included.
Contested is a planner risk label, not an independent reconstruction of server-side opponent reach.
The observed WR throws were Floaters; this window does not validate the rare Bullet counterstrategy.
